sourceNotes: This pass started from https://www.cannabis.ca.gov on 2026-09-08 and stayed on cannabis.ca.gov. What’s Legal answers adult-use purchase, the six-plant home grow, medicinal purchase at 18 with a physician recommendation, medicinal home grow when a physician recommends more plants, and the ban on use in public places such as restaurants or bars. Responsible cannabis use answers adult possession at 21 and medicinal use at 18 with a physician recommendation or medical marijuana ID card. The stored possession-limit sentence and the stitched medicinal-buy paragraph are no longer on What’s Legal. The stored Compassionate Use Act plant-count excerpt is not on California’s cannabis laws. The Health and Safety Code citations on leginfo.legislature.ca.gov were replaced because that host is not the requested source and DCC HTML already answers public and on-site use. Temporary cannabis events allow onsite consumption, but What’s Legal still tells consumers they cannot use cannabis in restaurants or bars. Fetch with browser headers returns 200 and the excerpts are in the HTML, so these rows do not need a browser.
